conversation.user: I'm doing a backyard office, 420 sq. ft. of wall at 10 inches, and I was planning on pre-cast blocks.
conversation.assistant:
Pre-cast blocks are a fantastic choice for a backyard office because they let you skip the drying wait time and get right to building. For roughly 420 square feet of wall area at a 10-inch thickness, you will need about 10 to 12 cubic meters of material volume. 

Since you are opting for pre-cast blocks, your framing will carry the structural loads while this non-load-bearing infill handles superior insulation and moisture regulation. Plus, all our materials are 100% legal, contain 0% THC, are completely unrelated to recreational marijuana, and offer wonderful fire-resistant safety for your workspace. Just remember that these figures are planning estimates, not stamped engineering for your local permits.

Would you prefer to use 12-inch blocks for maximum thermal performance, or stick with the 10-inch thickness to preserve a bit more interior floor space?
